intro: A drawer at Bletchley Park was found to have a false bottom. Beneath it: a stack of intercepts that were never logged, each one pinned to a different page of a crossword.
echo: A nobody, a zero and a secret, all spelled the same way.

puzzles.title: Menu
puzzles.flavor: The Senate admitted only the indivisible.

partials.e53897afc024e9ee991c21a04aa39241ba0cd2b3: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

hints: Read the numerals. They're all prime. Is there a natural way to number the primes?

puzzles.title: Cillies
puzzles.flavor: Some letters stand tall; most stay low. Something in here has been through the looking glass.

hints: Two kinds of letter, big and small. How many of them would you need to spell twenty-six different things? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Depth
puzzles.flavor: Nothing is missing. Nothing is where it was.

hints: Each word is complete but shuffled. Start with the shortest ones: does a sentence appear?

puzzles.title: Banburismus
puzzles.flavor: Around the edges first; the point comes last.

partials.24e4068982a06bc4af173dd3fd96dd8ff90878e2: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

hints: All the letters of a sentence are here, but not in rows. Try walking the grid the way a snail would.

puzzles.title: Room Forty
puzzles.flavor: Arms out, arms up, arms down: a dance with no music.

partials.d6136a0fc5580cc0f4e6b6ed5a2718b6f1754025: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

hints: Imagine each of these as a person holding two flags out at arm's length. Sailors had an alphabet for that.

puzzles.title: Kiss
puzzles.flavor: Three letters to a strip, and a note of how long each word was.

partials.583305a8f8779fb5c32dde1a6316351a95d9a95f: So close. Exactly one thing is wrong here. Fix it (and remember what you fixed).

hints: The strips are alphabetised, not in order. The word lengths say where the breaks fall. Which strip could start the sentence?

meta.title: Meta: Hut Eight
meta.flavor: Every report is one slip away from perfect.
hints: Did every answer come out clean the first time? Each had exactly one wrong letter. Did you keep them?
